purpose: Editable decision and refactor policy. Changing this file changes processing policy, not preserved legacy evidence.
immutable_principles: Never delete legacy evidence during refactor; demote or quarantine instead.
Do not let a policy rule silently override an empirical/engineering claim; any policy override must be explicit and labeled.
Do not resolve technical/scientific conflicts by version number alone.

execution_artifact_precedence.notes: Use explicit superseded_for_execution declarations first. Revision recency may choose runtime artifacts only within the same artifact family and only when no contrary manifest exists.

step_order: Normalize scope: same platform, date, test condition, quantity definition, and baseline. If scopes differ, retain both claims as scoped rather than calling them contradictory.
Reject or quarantine claims violating arithmetic, units, chronology, conservation, known material/production constraints, or their own stated prerequisites.
For historical empirical facts, prefer direct contemporary/primary measurements and documented test conditions over later unsourced assertions.
For engineering feasibility/performance, prefer transparent calculations tied to physical inputs and validated historical analogs; retain sensitivity ranges where inputs are uncertain.
For scenario consequences, require a causal chain through intermediate state variables; do not promote narrative outcome to technical evidence.
A later synthesis does not automatically defeat an earlier, better-supported technical claim. A later explicit refutation with stronger evidence does.
If evidence is genuinely non-decisive, preserve both, mark conflict_status=unresolved, and exclude the disputed value from automatic runtime injection.

claim_classes.historical_fact: dates, historical equipment performance, OOB, observed tests
claim_classes.engineering_derivation: performance or reliability derived from scenario technical changes
claim_classes.scenario_realization: whether a technically possible change is adopted/deployed by a date

history_rewind_policy.checkpoint_model: postwar history is a chain of independently restartable checkpoints; changing a checkpoint invalidates descendants, not ancestors
history_rewind_policy.upstream_change: changes to CORE/TECH/PREWAR that alter WARSTART create a new WARSTART revision and invalidate all descendant wartime checkpoints unless explicitly revalidated
history_rewind_policy.technical_baseline: technical index is orthogonal to checkpoint state; checkpoints store only technical maturation deltas and baseline revision references

runtime_handout_policy.source: generated projection of checkpoint + technical index + event tags; never a separate source of truth
runtime_handout_policy.unknown_behavior: UNKNOWN blocks final event computation unless explicitly waived with reason.

integration_policy.principle: Do not treat small improvements as isolated percentage bumps; map them into causal stages and integrate through shared intermediate variables.
integration_policy.diagnostic_product: A naive product of stage improvements may be used as an upper-bound/warning diagnostic, never automatically as a canonical combat multiplier.
